weaknesses.title: CSRF — Memory operations lacking anti-CSRF tokens (GET /rest/memories/)

weaknesses.title: Insecure Direct Object Reference (IDOR) — Parameter-based memory enumeration (GET /rest/memories/?id=1)
weaknesses.rationale: If the API supports querying specific memories by ID through query parameters, an attacker could enumerate and access unauthorized memory records by incrementing IDs.

weaknesses.title: Broken Access Control — Unauthenticated memory access (GET /rest/memories/)
weaknesses.rationale: The endpoint might allow unauthenticated requests to retrieve sensitive memory data if proper authentication checks are missing.

weaknesses.title: Information Disclosure — Memory metadata exposure (GET /rest/memories/)
weaknesses.rationale: The response might contain unintended sensitive information about users, system configurations, or internal structures within the memory data.

weaknesses.title: Server-Side Request Forgery (SSRF) — Backend memory fetching (GET /rest/memories/)
weaknesses.rationale: If memories include references to external resources, the backend might make requests to these resources, potentially allowing SSRF if user-controlled URLs are processed.

weaknesses.title: JSON Injection — Malformed memory content parsing (GET /rest/memories/)
weaknesses.rationale: If memory contents are improperly sanitized before inclusion in JSON responses, specially crafted data could break JSON structure and lead to client-side exploitation.
